label: can, could, will be able to

misconceptions.label: can, could, will be able to confondus
misconceptions.explanation: La capacité se dit can au présent, could au passé, will be able to au futur. Le marqueur de temps de la phrase (now, when he was five, next month) décide.

misconceptions.label: Capacité confondue avec l’obligation
misconceptions.explanation: Must exprime une obligation, pas une capacité. Pour dire qu’on sait ou qu’on peut faire quelque chose, on emploie can, could ou will be able to.

params.s: pick([['the cabman', 3, 'he'], ['Mrs Hudson', 3, 'she'], ['the baker', 3, 'he'], ['a sailor', 3, 'he'], ['the flower girl', 3, 'she'], ['the night watchman', 3, 'he']])
params.act: pick(['read the timetable', 'speak French', 'drive a cab', 'pick a lock', 'swim across the Thames', 'whistle like a train', 'climb onto the roof'])

let.lead: ['Now, ' ~ s[0], 'When ' ~ s[0] ~ ' was ten, ' ~ s[2], 'Next month, after a few lessons, ' ~ s[0]][k]
